name: io.github.farhan6667/no-api-media-mcp
title: No API Media
description: Images and videos from your ChatGPT, Google AI Pro, Higgsfield and Grok subscriptions, plus a local media studio. No API keys.

environmentVariables.name: NOAPI_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Private browser profile and state folder

environmentVariables.name: NOAPI_OUTPUT_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Folders the server may write to

environmentVariables.name: NOAPI_GOOGLE_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Which signed-in Google account to use

environmentVariables.name: NOAPI_MIN_GAP
environmentVariables.description: Seconds between two generations on one provider

environmentVariables.name: NOAPI_CHROME
environmentVariables.description: Path to Google Chrome if not auto-detected

environmentVariables.name: NOAPI_SHARE_BROWSER
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to let several sessions use the signed-in browser as separate tabs at once (opens a loopback-only devtools port while it is open). Default off: a second session waits in a queue.

environmentVariables.name: NO_API_MEDIA_KEEP_METADATA
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to keep embedded metadata (EXIF/XMP/C2PA) in media_optimize output instead of stripping it
